tools.name: home_activity
tools.title: Recent household activity
tools.description: Returns a digest of recent changes from the audit log — who changed what, when, and whether it came through an assistant — redacted so another member's private notes and documents show only that something private happened; admin only, as the Log itself is.

since.description: ISO timestamp or date; only changes at or after this are returned.

until.description: Optional ISO timestamp or date upper bound.

tools.name: home_admin_status
tools.title: Household service status
tools.description: Admin only. Returns how much space the household is using — database and object storage, broken down by module — and how notification delivery has been going lately.

refresh.description: Recompute rather than serving the cached snapshot. Costs a full storage scan.

tools.name: home_chat_conversations
tools.title: Chat conversations
tools.description: Lists the conversations the caller is in, with each one's unread count and how far back they may read; it is the only place an unread count is reported.

tools.name: home_chat_messages
tools.title: Read a chat thread
tools.description: Returns the newest messages of one conversation the caller is a member of, from their history floor onward; reading a thread is recorded in the Log as a conversation and a count, never as its contents.

tools.name: home_documents_pin
tools.title: Pin a document
tools.description: Pins or unpins a document on the dashboard, either for the whole household or just for the caller; a private document can only ever be pinned personally.

tools.name: home_documents_tree
tools.title: Documents tree
tools.description: Returns the folder tree of the household's shared documents, or with scope "private" the caller's own; pass document for one document's metadata, and read its contents with the home://documents/ resource.

document.description: Document id. Returns that document's metadata and its path, from whichever root holds it — so send it alone, without scope or include_archived.

include_archived.description: Only for a tree read. Not with document.

scope.description: Which root to read. "private" is the CALLER's own; there is no way to name another member's. Not with document.

tools.name: home_documents_update
tools.title: Rename a document
tools.description: Changes a document's title, description or archived flag; the FILE itself is never replaced, because there is no upload tool.

tools.name: home_electricity_advance_add
tools.title: Record a new advance schedule
tools.description: Starts a new version of the monthly advance (záloha) from a date, in Kč, with the day of the month it falls due; it governs every month from that date until the next version, and earlier months keep the version they were billed under.

due_day.description: Day of the month. Stored raw and clamped when read, so 31 still means "the last day" in February.

tools.name: home_electricity_reading_add
tools.title: Record a meter reading
tools.description: Records one dated reading of both registers in kWh; both must be non-decreasing against the readings on EITHER side of the date, because with meter replacement out of scope a falling counter is always a typo.

read_on.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in the household timezone.

vt_kwh.description: The high-tariff (VT) register, in kWh as the meter shows it.

tools.name: home_electricity_readings
tools.title: Meter readings
tools.description: Lists the household's meter readings newest first, both registers in kWh, with how many days ago the newest one was taken.

tools.name: home_electricity_summary
tools.title: Electricity balance
tools.description: Returns the current billing period's consumption, cost so far, advances paid and the resulting overpayment or underpayment, all computed on read; pass period_id for an older period.

tools.name: home_events_complete
tools.title: Tick off a reminder
tools.description: Marks one occurrence's reminder as done, which is what removes it from the household's Připomínky; it is per occurrence, so ticking one date leaves the rest of a recurring event alone.

occurrence_on.description: The occurrence's ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), as home_events_upcoming reports it.

tools.name: home_events_create
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Adds a household event on a date, optionally recurring by RRULE and optionally reminding — reminder_lead "0d" reminds on the day itself, not the day before.

tools.name: home_events_upcoming
tools.title: Upcoming events
tools.description: Returns the household's events occurring in a date window, recurrences expanded, each with whether its reminder has been ticked off; defaults to the next 30 days.

to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days after from.

tools.name: home_events_update
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Changes an event's title, date, description, recurrence, reminder or archived flag; archiving is how the household retires an event, and unlike a delete it is reversible.

tools.name: home_finance_month_create
tools.title: Record a month
tools.description: Records one month's two incomes and its four percentage rates, which must be whole numbers summing to 100; the split is computed from them and never sent. Call home_finance_months first — the previous month's rates are usually the ones to repeat.

month.description: YYYY-MM. Unique — one row per month.

rates.description: All four, and they must sum to 100. A month has no split without them, so there is no default.

tools.name: home_finance_month_update
tools.title: Correct a month
tools.description: Changes a recorded month's incomes or its whole four-value rate block; a partial rate block is refused rather than silently zeroing the other three.

tools.name: home_finance_months
tools.title: Monthly income split
tools.description: Lists the household's recorded months newest first, each with both incomes, the four rates and the DERIVED split; pass month for one month by its YYYY-MM key.

limit.description: How many months to list, newest first. Only for the listing — not with month.

month.description: A single month as YYYY-MM. Resolved directly, so any recorded month answers however far back it is. Do not send limit beside it.

tools.name: home_garden_harvest_log
tools.title: Record a harvest
tools.description: Records what was picked from one planting, on a date, in a unit — the quantity must be strictly positive, because a zero row still flips the planting to harvesting and makes the real figure un-enterable later.

destination.description: Where it went: eaten fresh, into storage, given away, or composted.

unit.description: Defaults to the crop's own unit, which is usually the one to keep.

tools.name: home_garden_plan
tools.title: Season plan
tools.description: Returns one season's plantings — what is in which bed, with planned and actual dates — plus the season's frost anchors and status; defaults to the current year.

bed_id.description: A bed id from this same tool. An id that names no bed is refused rather than answered with an empty plan.

tools.name: home_garden_planting_create
tools.title: Plant something
tools.description: Records a planting of one crop in one bed for a season, which is what generates its sowing, transplanting and harvest jobs; give its size as EITHER area_m2 OR plant_count — exactly one of the two, never both and never neither — and call home_garden_plan first for the bed and crop ids.

area_m2.description: Square metres. Give this OR plant_count — never both, never neither.

location_label.description: For a planting that is not in a numbered bed.

plant_count.description: Number of plants. Give this OR area_m2 — never both, never neither.

plant_id.description: The crop, from the knowledge base.

season_year.description: Defaults to the current year. The season must already exist and be open.

tools.name: home_garden_task_complete
tools.title: Tick off a garden job
tools.description: Marks one garden job done; reopening one is deliberately not available here, because undoing somebody else's record of work they did is not an assistant's call.

tools.name: home_garden_task_create
tools.title: Add a garden job
tools.description: Adds a manual job to the current season with a Czech title and a date window; the season must be open, because a closed year is the rotation history the plan checks read.

bed_id.description: A bed id from home_garden_plan — the id, not the code the work list prints. An id that names no bed is refused.

kind.description: What kind of job it is. Use "other" when none of the rest fits.

planting_id.description: A planting id from home_garden_plan. An id that names no planting is refused.

season_year.description: Defaults to the season the window falls in.

title_cs.description: What to do, in Czech — this is what appears on the work list.

window_to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after window_from.

tools.name: home_garden_tasks
tools.title: Garden work
tools.description: Returns the garden jobs whose window overlaps a date range — sowing, transplanting, watering, harvesting — with which are overdue; defaults to the next fourteen days.

bed_id.description: A bed id from home_garden_plan. An id that names no bed is refused rather than answered with an empty list.

status.description: Filter by status. Omit for every status.

to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 14 days after from.

tools.name: home_get
tools.title: Get one entity
tools.description: Returns one entity in full by the kind and id a search hit reported, e.g. kind "notes.note"; use it after home_search rather than guessing an id.

tools.name: home_lists
tools.title: Household lists
tools.description: With no arguments lists every published list and what it names; with keys, resolves those lists to their items for the calling member — the WHICH behind home_metrics's HOW MANY.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), in the household timezone.

keys.description: List keys to resolve. Omit to list the catalog instead.

tools.name: home_metrics
tools.title: Household metrics
tools.description: With no arguments lists every published metric and what it counts; with keys, resolves those metrics to numbers for the calling member — two jobs in one tool, deliberately, to spend one slot instead of two.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), in the household timezone.

keys.description: Metric keys to resolve. Omit to list the catalog instead.

tools.name: home_notes_create
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: Writes a new Markdown note into the shared tree, or with scope "private" into the caller's own; a note created under a folder inherits that folder's scope, and disagreeing with it is refused.

folder_id.description: Optional parent folder. Omit for the root of the chosen scope.

tools.name: home_notes_pin
tools.title: Pin a note
tools.description: Pins or unpins a note on the dashboard, either for the whole household or just for the caller; a private note can only ever be pinned personally.

tools.name: home_notes_tree
tools.title: Notes tree
tools.description: Returns the folder tree of the household's shared notes, or with scope "private" the caller's own private notes; pass note for one note's full Markdown body.

note.description: Note id. Returns that note in full, including its Markdown body.

scope.description: Which root to read. "private" is the CALLER's own; there is no way to name another member's.

tools.name: home_notes_update
tools.title: Update a note
tools.description: Replaces a note's title, Markdown body or archived flag; the body is replaced whole, so read it with home_notes_tree first if you mean to append rather than overwrite.

tools.name: home_search
tools.title: Search the household
tools.description: Searches notes, documents, tasks, events, garden records and chat at once and returns a MERGE ordered by exact-title-match then recency — not a relevance ranking, because scores from separate indexes are not comparable — with a per-module budget so one chatty module cannot crowd out the rest.

in.description: Optional module names to restrict the search to, e.g. ["notes","documents"].

query.description: The search terms, in Czech, as the member would type them.

tools.name: home_today
tools.title: What is due today
tools.description: Returns everything due or overdue for the calling member today — reminders, tasks and garden work — composed entirely from the published metric and list catalogs, so it costs no module query; it deliberately carries no chat unread count.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to answer for instead of today, in the household timezone.

tools.name: home_todo_boards
tools.title: To-do boards
tools.description: Lists the to-do boards; pass board for one board's full tree of columns and cards, or card for one card with its checklist, links and labels.

board.description: Board id. Returns that board's columns and their cards.

card.description: Card id. Returns that card in full, including its checklist.

query.description: Optional text filter applied to the board tree's card titles.

tools.name: home_todo_card_create
tools.title: Create a card
tools.description: Adds a card to a column; call home_todo_boards first to get the column id, because a column id is not guessable from a board id.

tools.name: home_todo_card_move
tools.title: Move a card
tools.description: Moves a card to another column — moving it into a column of kind "done" is how a task is completed — optionally anchored before a named card.

before_card_id.description: Optional: place it immediately before this card. Omit to append at the end.

tools.name: home_todo_card_update
tools.title: Update a card
tools.description: Changes a card's title, notes or archived flag; archiving is how a household removes a card, and it is reversible where a delete would not be.

tools.name: home_todo_checklist
tools.title: Change a card's checklist
tools.description: Adds an item to a card's checklist, or ticks and unticks an existing one, and returns the whole checklist afterwards; reading a checklist without changing it is home_todo_boards with card.

add.description: Text of a new checklist item to append.

done.description: The state to set item_id to.

item_id.description: Existing item to tick or untick; requires done.

tools.name: home_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Returns the calling member's id, display name, roles, which modules this token exposes, the household timezone and today's date; call it once at the start of a session so every later date is unambiguous.

resource_templates.name: attachment
resource_templates.title: Příloha v chatu
resource_templates.description: Jedna příloha z konverzace, které je volající členem.

resource_templates.name: document
resource_templates.title: Dokument
resource_templates.description: Jeden dokument podle své cesty ve stromu; soukromé mají prefix soukrome/.

resource_templates.name: note
resource_templates.title: Poznámka
resource_templates.description: Jedna poznámka podle své cesty ve stromu; soukromé mají prefix soukrome/.

prompts.name: co-mě-čeká
prompts.title: Co mě čeká
prompts.description: Přehled dneška a nejbližších dnů — připomínky, úkoly, práce na zahradě.
prompts.text:
Zjisti, co mě dnes čeká.

1. Zavolej `home_whoami`, ať víš, kdo jsem a jaké je dnes datum.
2. Zavolej `home_today` — vrátí připomínky, úkoly i zahradní práci na dnešek.
3. Zavolej `home_events_upcoming` na příštích sedm dní.
4. Zavolej `home_chat_conversations` a zmiň jen počet nepřečtených zpráv, ne jejich obsah.

Odpověz česky, stručně, jako by mi to někdo řekl u snídaně: nejdřív to, co má termín dnes, pak zbytek týdne. Když není nic, řekni to jednou větou — nevymýšlej úkoly a nenavrhuj, co bych mohl dělat.

prompts.name: měsíční-uzávěrka
prompts.title: Měsíční uzávěrka
prompts.description: Projde finance a elektřinu za měsíc a řekne, co ještě chybí zapsat.
prompts.text:
Projdi se mnou uzávěrku měsíce.

Měsíc, o který jde: {{měsíc}}
(Když je tenhle řádek prázdný, vezmi měsíc předcházející dnešnímu datu.)

1. Zavolej `home_whoami` kvůli dnešnímu datu.
2. Zavolej `home_finance_months` na ten měsíc. Když chybí, řekni to — nezakládej ho sám.
3. Zavolej `home_electricity_summary` a `home_electricity_readings`.

Napiš česky: jestli jsou příjmy za měsíc zapsané, jaký vyšel rozpad, jestli je odečet elektroměru čerstvý, a jestli vychází nedoplatek nebo přeplatek. Na konci uveď seznam toho, co ještě chybí zapsat — a počkej, až ti řeknu, co s tím.

prompts.name: nákup
prompts.title: Nákupní seznam
prompts.description: Sestaví nákupní seznam z poznámek a úkolů, se zásobami ze zahrady.
prompts.text:
Sestav nákupní seznam.

1. Zavolej `home_search` s dotazem "nákup" — projde poznámky i úkoly.
2. Otevři nalezené poznámky přes `home_notes_tree` s parametrem `note`.
3. Zavolej `home_todo_boards` a projdi karty, které vypadají jako nákup.

Slož z toho jeden seznam po kategoriích (pečivo, mléčné, zelenina, drogerie, ostatní). Duplicity slouč. Pokud najdeš věc, kterou máme podle zahrady doma, napiš to k položce místo toho, abys ji tiše vynechal — rozhodnutí je moje.

Nic nikam nezapisuj, dokud tě o to nepožádám.

prompts.name: večeře-z-toho-co-máme
prompts.title: Večeře z toho, co máme
prompts.description: Navrhne večeři ze zahradních zásob a poslední sklizně.
prompts.text:
Navrhni večeři z toho, co máme doma.

1. Zavolej `home_search` s dotazem "recept" a projdi, co v poznámkách je.
2. Zavolej `home_garden_plan` a `home_garden_tasks` — co je teď na zahradě a co se právě sklízí.

O téhle domácnosti platí: vaříme spíš jednoduše a večer, maso párkrát týdně, a co je ze zahrady, to se snažíme sníst dřív, než se to zkazí. Navrhni dvě varianty, u každé napiš, co k ní chybí koupit.

⚠ Zásoby ve skladu (sklad zahrady) přes MCP zatím vidět nejsou — jestli si nejsi jistý, co je doma, zeptej se místo hádání.

prompts.name: zahrada-týden
prompts.title: Zahrada na týden
prompts.description: Co je na zahradě potřeba udělat tento týden a co je po termínu.
prompts.text:
Řekni mi, co je tento týden potřeba na zahradě.

1. Zavolej `home_whoami` kvůli datu.
2. Zavolej `home_garden_tasks` na příštích sedm dní.
3. Zavolej `home_garden_plan` — ať víš, co kde roste.

Seřaď to podle záhonů, ne podle data: chodí se po zahradě, ne po kalendáři. Co je po termínu, dej nahoru a označ to. Když je něco hotové, můžu tě požádat o `home_garden_task_complete` — sám nic neodškrtávej.
